newsitem.title: USA: Complete gets contracts worth $6.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Complete gets contracts worth $6.5 mln.

text.p: Complete Management Inc said Friday it has negotiated and financed the acquisition of doctors' practices for two clients, which should add about $6.5 million to Complete's 1997 revenues.
These two transactions bring to more than 117 the number of physicians under full management and some 950 physicians who are provided partial services by Complete.
For Northern Metropolitan Medical PC, Complete negotiated and financed the acquisition of a nine-physician primary care practice in Beacon, Cold Spring and Yorktown, N.Y.
On behalf of an unnamed client, Complete negotiated and financed the acquisition of a seven-physician primary and emergency care practice in Cliffside Park, N.J..

Steve Rabinovici, Complete chief executive, said "Both of these transactions are important in the expansion of CMI's services. One marks our entry into a market outside of New York State, while the other is part of our ongoing strategic plan that we developed with NMM to enable NMM to become the dominant primary care provider in their area."
